themes.title: Nvidia lifts futures
themes.summary: Nvidia shares rose about 3.7% in pre-market trading after it forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, above the LSEG analyst average of $125.25 billion (MarketScreener/Reuters).

themes.title: AI infrastructure stocks rally early
themes.summary: In pre-market trading AMD rose 3%, Micron 3.4% and Marvell 4.4%, while CoreWeave gained 6.5% and Nebius 8.1% (MarketScreener/Reuters).

themes.title: Second straight selloff Tuesday
themes.summary: All three major indexes fell for a second day before Nvidia's report; Home Depot fell 2.45% as it named a new CEO and Disney fell 1.48% after its results (MarketScreener/Reuters; Stock Titan).

themes.title: December rate hike nearly priced in
themes.summary: Markets almost fully price a quarter-point Fed rate increase next month; New York Fed President John Williams said Tuesday another hike is likely needed but opposed an aggressive path (MarketScreener/Reuters).

themes.title: Oil eases on stockpile build
themes.summary: API data showed U.S. crude inventories up 5.28 million barrels and gasoline up 5.12 million barrels, though Strait of Hormuz disruptions limited losses (HDFC Sky).
